faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Helpful answers to common questions about appointments and assessments.
faq.q1: What happens during the first speech or hearing consultation?
faq.a1: During the first visit, our specialist conducts a detailed case history discussion and standard clinical assessment. For children, this is conducted through engaging, play-based activities to evaluate speech clarity, vocabulary, and comprehension without causing stress. For hearing concerns, an audiometric evaluation is performed.
faq.q2: How long does an assessment session take?
faq.a2: An initial consultation typically takes 45 to 60 minutes. This allows sufficient time for observation, testing, and a calm discussion with parents or family members about the findings.
faq.q3: How do I know if my child needs a speech assessment?
faq.a3: If your child is not meeting age-appropriate speech milestones (such as not using single words by 16–18 months, unclear speech past 3 years, difficulty following simple instructions, or noticeable stammering), an early evaluation helps identify if support is beneficial.
faq.q4: Do I need to book an appointment before visiting?
faq.a4: Yes, we recommend booking an appointment in advance via WhatsApp or phone so that our specialists can allocate dedicated, uninterrupted time for your consultation.
faq.q5: What should I bring to our first visit?
faq.a5: Please bring any previous medical records, past hearing test reports, school feedback reports (for school-age children), and a list of specific questions or observations you have noticed at home.

about.storyP1: Saukhya was founded with a single mission: to provide empathetic, evidence-based speech, language, and hearing care to families in and around Vikhroli, Mumbai.
about.storyP2: Communication and hearing are fundamental to how we learn, express emotions, and connect with loved ones. We strive to make therapy an encouraging, stress-free experience for children, adults, and seniors alike.
about.approachP: We believe effective care starts with listening. We prioritize thorough clinical assessments, realistic milestone setting, transparent parent counseling, and engaging home practice routines. We do not make exaggerated outcome guarantees; we focus on steady, measurable progress.
about.reason1Desc: Ethical care delivered by trained professionals adhering to recognized clinical standards.
about.reason2Desc: A welcoming, toy-assisted environment where children feel safe and excited to participate.
about.reason3Desc: Parents are guided at every stage with practical strategies for daily home reinforcement.
about.reason4Desc: Integrated diagnosis and rehabilitation without having to travel to multiple centers.
about.reason5Desc: Easily accessible for families across Eastern Mumbai and Central suburbs.
about.communityDesc: We regularly organize community awareness initiatives and free screening camps to identify developmental speech and hearing concerns early.
about.promiseDesc: Honesty, patient dignity, privacy, and clear communication are at the heart of everything we do. We will always give you our objective clinical guidance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your information with care and confidentiality.
privacy.intro: At Saukhya Speech, Language and Hearing Clinic, we are committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of our patients, parents, and website visitors in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act of India.
privacy.collectionDesc: When you contact us via WhatsApp, phone, or optional camp registration forms, we may receive your name, phone number, and brief description of your inquiry. We only use this information to respond to your inquiry and schedule appointments.
privacy.noMedicalTitle: 2. What We Do NOT Collect On This Website
privacy.noMedicalDesc: This website does not store medical history, diagnosis records, or payment card details. No medical forms or health data are collected or processed by third-party tracking scripts on this website.
privacy.whatsappDesc: When you click our WhatsApp booking buttons, your device directly opens WhatsApp to send a message to our clinic number. WhatsApp's own end-to-end encryption and terms apply to your chat.
privacy.analyticsDesc: We use lightweight, privacy-conscious analytics to count total page visits and understand high-level button clicks (e.g. click to call). We do NOT track individual personal identities, IP addresses, or cross-site behaviors.
privacy.noSharingDesc: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties, advertisers, or marketing agencies.
privacy.rightsDesc: You may request the deletion or correction of your contact details at any time by contacting our clinic directly via phone or email.
privacy.contactDesc: If you have questions about this privacy notice, please reach out to us at contact@saukhyaclinic.com or call our clinic.
